title: Clinical Treatment of Viral Hemorrhagic Fevers (VHFs) | Viral Hemorrhagic Fevers (VHFs) | CDC
content: May 6, 2024 Clinical Treatment of Viral Hemorrhagic Fevers (VHFs) Key points Healthcare providers should notify their health department and CDC to determine a patient's course of treatment. FDA-approved therapeutics do not exist for most viral hemorrhagic fevers. Supportive care is vital for patients with suspected or confirmed VHFs. Special precautions are needed to safely provide care like hemodialysis to VHF patients.
